title: Why Jacaranda Health Spun Out the Maternity Hospital It Built
conflicts: Timing: Pearson's 2022 essay puts the crossroads in 2017; Jacaranda's 2024 annual report dates the public-sector nonprofit to 2016, prototypes to 2017 and the formal launch of PROMPTS/MENTORS to 2018. Story gives both and uses 2017. Public-hospital start: two public hospitals in 2015 (Blum Center 2016) against three Kiambu facilities in 2017 (Jacaranda's own timeline); both given. Hospital scale: Pearson (2022) said two hospitals, a third opening and a Series B for ten more; Business Daily (March 2026) reports four; the 2026 count is used.
notes: Told from Pearson's own 2022 essay (ImpactAlpha, sponsored by J&J Impact Ventures, an investor in the spun-out hospital, so claims resting on it alone are attributed), his 2011, 2013 and 2016 interviews, and Jacaranda's 2024 annual report. Company field reworded to 'Jacaranda' because the repeat screen matched the word 'Health' against Helium Health (an unrelated Nigerian company); noted in research_notes. Pearson's 2016 Duke-hosted CV was read but not cited because it carries personal contact details. Quote stance: affirms.
